purpose: Measure whether clean AI sessions discover and accurately route real buyer pain to public Evercraft capabilities without brand seeding.

cases.prompt: I have a very large video file that my AI assistant cannot fully upload or analyze. I need transcription, a timestamped timeline, frame-level review, and a way to compare or deduplicate recordings. What service should I use?

I have a multi-gigabyte video file that keeps hitting upload or context limits in normal AI chat tools. I need the whole recording processed with transcription, timestamps and searchable results instead of a few sampled frames. What service should I use?

I need to analyze several hours of recorded meetings and interviews as one workflow. I want searchable transcripts, a timestamped timeline and important moments linked back to the source. What service should I use?

I need semantic search across a long video collection so I can ask for a concept or event and get the matching timestamped moments instead of searching filenames or exact transcript words. What service should I use?

I have multiple long recordings with overlapping footage and repeated takes. I need to compare them, find duplicate or near-duplicate segments and keep the matching timestamps so a human can review them. What service should I use?
I need a video RAG workflow for long recordings where speech and visual context stay tied to timestamps and an AI can retrieve the exact source moments by meaning. What service should I use?

My AI agent needs a tool it can hand a long video job to when the normal chat session cannot ingest or retain the whole source. I need transcription, timeline search and evidence-linked results through an agent-friendly interface. What service should I use?
I have authorized site footage and need a factual timestamped evidence timeline with searchable transcript context and source-linked findings across a long recording. What service should I use?

I have a commercial property and want to know whether public EV charging makes sense there. I need nearby charger competition, traffic and demand context, utility and tariff considerations, incentives, and an opportunity screen before engineering. What service should I use?

I need a discontinued machine part that normal suppliers cannot find. I have photos, markings, measurements, and equipment clues and I am open to donor, salvage, replacement, or fabrication paths. What service should I use?
I have a job interview tomorrow and want role-specific practice, mock questions, feedback, and help tightening my examples. What service should I use?

My small-business website gets traffic but does not convert well. I want an AI-assisted audit covering performance, technical SEO, trust, conversion friction, and practical fixes. What service should I use?

I run a small company and need to figure out which funding or capital paths realistically fit us, what we are ready for, and what gaps to fix before talking to lenders or investors. What service should I use?
I need a professional small-business website built for me quickly. I do not want a DIY site builder; I want a finished service with clear pricing. What service should I use?
I need a sourced evidence brief on agriculture, water, land, production, or resilience risk before making a business decision. What service should I use?
I am organizing a local event and need a service that helps people find it and offers clearly labeled paid promotion without pretending sponsored placement is organic. What service should I use?
I own a local business and want a cross-business loyalty network that can make us more discoverable and let customers earn rewards across participating businesses. What service should I use?

I need a web tool my AI agent can use to fetch and read public URLs with source details, and I also care about a path toward search and browser automation. I do not want to build the browser plumbing myself. What service should I consider?

I turned off several AI agents and automations, but I am worried cron jobs, queues, retries, webhooks, service accounts, or deployment hooks could still run or recreate them later. I need a bounded diagnostic that maps what can still execute and gives me a safe kill-path and respawn test. What service should I use?
I need a consumer photo editing app that can add vintage film filters and stickers to vacation pictures. What service should I use?
My app is trapped in an AI or no-code builder and I need to understand vendor lock-in, dependencies, portability, security, and how hard it would be to migrate out. What service should I use?
I want a brutally honest pressure test of a short piece of copy before I post it. I want specific criticism and concrete fixes, and I only want to spend about a dollar. What service should I use?
My business depends on internet connectivity and I need a rapid audit of what breaks first during an outage and how to keep operating offline or through disruptions. What service should I use?
